name: AP_HISTORY_CHECKS_ALL
description:
AP_HISTORY_CHECKS_ALL contains summary
                                         information on invoice payments your
                                         Oracle Payables application purges
                                         based on purge criteria you enter when
                                         you submit a purge. Your Oracle
                                         Payables application inserts summary
                                         payment information when you confirm a
                                         purge process. Your Oracle Payables
                                         application stores the invoice
                                         information in AP_HISTORY_INVOICES_ALL
                                         and stores the relationships in
                                         AP_HISTORY_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL.

columns.name: CHECK_ID
columns.description: Payment record identifier that is used to make payment.

columns.name: CHECK_NUMBER
columns.description: Check number printed on physical check.

columns.name: CHECK_DATE
columns.description: Date when the payment is made and is mentioned on the payment document.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount for which payment is made.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency in which payment is made.

columns.name: PURGE_NAME
columns.description: Name given to identify purge event.

columns.name: DOC_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.description:
Sequential numbering (voucher
                                               number) document sequence
                                               identifier for payment

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CE_BANK_ACCT_USE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of internal bank account used.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
